title: SteerBench: A Standardized Benchmark for Safety Concept Steering Evaluation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Standardized benchmarks enable cumulative progress. Without them, the field cannot compare methods. Clear chain from benchmark availability to accelerated research progress.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Dataset curation (500 prompt pairs per concept) is labor-intensive but not technically complex. Evaluation protocol design requires research methodology knowledge. Leaderboard infrastructure is a software engineering task. Mixed skill requirements.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 500 prompt pairs times 4 concepts = 2000 pairs, plus evaluation protocol, plus leaderboard infrastructure. This is a multi-month community resource project, not a 30-hour project. Far too broad.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
